## Group comparison

Targeted compounds are compared by their concentrations, non-targeted features by their normalized,
blank-subtracted intensities (features detected in at least half of the study samples).
`r if (length(study_classes) > 2) paste0("The data has ", length(study_classes), " study groups; the first two (", study_classes[1], ", ", study_classes[2], ") are compared.") else ""`

```{r}
grp <- study_classes[1:2]
cmp_t <- study_long |> filter(Class %in% grp) |>
  group_by(Feature = feature_name) |>
  filter(mean(status == "Valid") >= 0.5) |>
  summarise(
    med1 = median(conc[Class == grp[1]], na.rm = TRUE),
    med2 = median(conc[Class == grp[2]], na.rm = TRUE),
    p = tryCatch(wilcox.test(conc[Class == grp[1]], conc[Class == grp[2]])$p.value, error = \(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(Type = "Targeted (concentration)")
# Non-targeted features, all batches together
nt_ids <- feat$feature_id[feat$type == "Non-targeted"]
nt_m <- do.call(cbind, lapply(tr[["normalized - blank"]], \(se) se[[BLK]][nt_ids, , drop = FALSE]))
nt_cd <- bind_rows(lapply(tr[["normalized - blank"]], \(se) tibble::as_tibble(SumExp::col_df(se))))
g1 <- nt_cd$Class == grp[1] & nt_cd$.ctrl_cat == ""
g2 <- nt_cd$Class == grp[2] & nt_cd$.ctrl_cat == ""
keep_f <- rowSums(!is.na(nt_m)) > 0 & rowMeans(nt_m[, g1 | g2] > 0, na.rm = TRUE) >= 0.5
nt_m <- nt_m[keep_f, , drop = FALSE]
cmp_nt <- tibble(
  Feature = feat$label[match(rownames(nt_m), feat$feature_id)],
  med1 = apply(nt_m[, g1], 1, median, na.rm = TRUE),
  med2 = apply(nt_m[, g2], 1, median, na.rm = TRUE),
  p = vapply(seq_len(nrow(nt_m)), \(i) tryCatch(wilcox.test(nt_m[i, g1], nt_m[i, g2])$p.value,
                                                 error = \(e) NA_real_), numeric(1)),
  Type = "Non-targeted (intensity)"
)
cmp <- bind_rows(cmp_t, cmp_nt) |>
  mutate(log2fc = log2((med2 + 1e-9) / (med1 + 1e-9)), q = p.adjust(p, "BH"),
         sig = ifelse(q < 0.05, paste(sub(" \\(.*", "", Type), "q < 0.05"), "Not significant"))
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
cat(sprintf('<div class="callout-q">%s vs %s: %d of %d targeted compounds and %d of %d non-targeted features differ (q &lt; 0.05).</div>',
            grp[2], grp[1], sum(cmp_t$Feature %in% cmp$Feature[cmp$q < 0.05 & cmp$Type == cmp_t$Type[1]]), nrow(cmp_t),
            sum(cmp$q < 0.05 & cmp$Type == "Non-targeted (intensity)", na.rm = TRUE), nrow(cmp_nt)))
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Fold change vs significance

```{r}
#| fig-height: 5.5
p_v <- ggplot(cmp, aes(log2fc, -log10(q), text = paste0(Feature, " (", Type, ")<br>log2 FC: ", round(log2fc, 2),
                                                          "<br>q: ", signif(q, 2)))) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey70") +
  geom_point(aes(color = sig, shape = Type), size = 2.2, alpha = .8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Targeted q < 0.05" = "#DD8452", "Non-targeted q < 0.05" = "#4C72B0",
                                "Not significant" = "#BDBDBD"), name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Targeted (concentration)" = 17, "Non-targeted (intensity)" = 16), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = paste0("log2 fold change (", grp[2], " / ", grp[1], ", medians)"), y = "-log10(q) (Wilcoxon, BH)")
plotly::ggplotly(p_v, tooltip = "text", height = 560)
```

### Table

```{r}
cmp |> transmute(Feature, Type = factor(Type), !!paste("Median", grp[1]) := signif(med1, 3),
                 !!paste("Median", grp[2]) := signif(med2, 3),
                 `log2 FC` = round(log2fc, 2), p = signif(p, 2), q = signif(q, 2)) |>
  arrange(q) |> dt()
```

:::

## Concentrations per group

The 12 compounds quantified in the most study samples.

```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 13
top <- study_long |> group_by(feature_name) |> summarise(v = mean(status == "Valid")) |>
  filter(v > 0) |> arrange(desc(v)) |> head(12) |> pull(feature_name)
if (length(top) == 0) note("No quantified compounds in the study samples.") else
conc_long |> filter(feature_name %in% top, status == "Valid", .ctrl_cat %in% c("", "QC")) |>
  mutate(group = ifelse(.ctrl_cat == "QC", "QC", Class)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = conc, fill = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = .6) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors, guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~feature_name, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = paste0("Concentration [", unit, "] (log10)"))
```
